mapper.select: SELECT store_id,user_id FROM pet_order WHERE id=#{orderId}

SELECT id,user_id,merchant_id,store_id,reservation_id,order_stage,payment_status, verification_status,pay_amount,discount_amount,payment_expire_at, cancel_reason,paid_at,version FROM pet_order WHERE id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT payment_id,source_event_id,channel_trade_no,channel_paid_amount, channel_paid_at,result_type FROM order_payment_result WHERE order_id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_order SET order_stage='PENDING_CONFIRM',payment_status='PAID', paid_at=#{paidAt},confirm_deadline=#{confirmDeadline},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND order_stage='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND payment_status='INIT' AND verification_status='UNVERIFIED' AND cancel_reason IS NULL AND canceled_at IS NULL

UPDATE pet_order SET payment_status='PAID',paid_at=#{paidAt},version=version+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND order_stage='CANCELED' AND payment_status='INIT' AND verification_status='UNVERIFIED' AND cancel_reason='PAYMENT_TIMEOUT'
